Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Appreciate you and the team sharing the use case for AcmeFin's customer support augmentation — helpful to understand the expected token volumes and the redaction/PII concerns.

A couple quick notes / next steps from my side:
- Confirmed: Redwood can enforce a training-on-customer-data opt-out for AcmeFin (no customer data will be used to improve Redwood models).
- We need a signed opt-out form to attach to the contract and for our compliance records — draft attached.
- Can you confirm preferred data residency for logs (US, EU) and retention windows for request logs and raw transcripts? You mentioned 30 days for logs in the call.
- CC'ing Jonas (solutions) to coordinate the security questionnaire pieces.

If you can return the completed opt-out form and confirm residency/retention by end of next week, we can include the opt-out in the SOW and keep the trial on track.

Thanks —

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our conversation. A few clarifications from my side:
- AcmeFin requires a firm opt-out: no usage of any customer-provided content for model training or improvement. Please confirm that this is contractual and not just a setting.
- For logs: we prefer US residency for the pilot; retention of request logs and raw transcripts at 30 days is acceptable.
- On PII: we will be redacting direct identifiers on our side, but please confirm Redwood's controls around ephemeral caching and whether any system-level logs store user content longer than the retention window.

I've attached a procurement checklist — procurement will need the signed opt-out form and a short security summary.

Sara Lopez
Director, Platform Integrations — AcmeFin
sara.lopez@acmefin.com
Attachment: acmefin-procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 24 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & confirmation: training-on-customer-data opt-out

Hi Sara —

Thanks — calling out answers inline:
- Opt-out: confirmed — we will include a contractual clause that explicitly prohibits Redwood from using AcmeFin customer data for model training or improvement. This is enforceable via the contract and recorded in our customer controls.
- Residency & retention: US residency for logs and 30-day retention for transcripts and request logs is noted.
- Caching/logging: Redwood's runtime uses ephemeral KV caches for low-latency serving; we have configurable retention and a hard delete process aligned to the retention window. System-level logs that contain request payloads are retained only per the retention policy; PII/identifiers can be redacted on ingest.

Rishi — can you confirm the specific documentation we can share for procurement (SOC2 scope, data flow diagram, and a short security summary)? Also please confirm the opt-out clause language we propose for inclusion in the SOW.

Marissa
